interpretation.mean_ci: Student-t 95 percent interval of whole-scene mean; not a future-scene prediction interval
interpretation.paired_ci: Marginal paired Student-t 95 percent; comparisons not multiplicity-adjusted
interpretation.component_means: For each scene divide its component seconds by that scene source count, then average scenes
interpretation.saving_percent: Primary percentage is (right mean - left mean) / right mean; scene-average ratios are separate
interpretation.historical_1000: Root comparison.html is not included in any result below
interpretation.generalization: Local simulator distribution only; no official score or completion guarantee inferred
